tactical_note: plan-derived decision, NOT a vocabulary output: the planned and the logged trajectory (both the kinematic integration of the action sequence from the same v0) are classified by ONE rule, tanitad.refs.refc_tactical.factor_from_kinematics through taniteval.four_families.maneuver_kinematics, on the path of each band re-expressed in the frame of the pose at the band start. The rule reads path geometry only (net path tangent, chord speeds); the goal that conditioned the plan is not an input of the rule. Thresholds are the programme's 2 s thresholds applied unchanged to each band (not rescaled to 4 s or 6 s)

strategic.state: REPORTED IN FULL (PI 2026-11-16: the strategic pause ended); never a pass by itself
strategic.tier_stamp: T0 HWM-ORACLE diagnostic on the oracle rows: the goal that conditioned the plan is the ENCODED TRUE FUTURE, so a cell on those plans measures the world model's use of an oracle goal, not a strategic decision and never a driving number. Rows of the predicted-goal arms (hwm_plan, flat_plan) are T1-kin
strategic.scope: S_ADH: an announced L/R turn at distance d_text with d_text + COMPLETE_M inside the plan's own arc; 1 if the plan's side-signed heading change over [0, d_text + COMPLETE_M] reaches theta; s_adh_deg is the same heading change in signed degrees (side-positive), the continuous twin. S_FALSE: no turn announced within the plan arc + 30 m, 1 if the plan's net heading change reaches 25 deg either side; the text does not announce bends or ramps the logged path takes, so S_FALSE is read ONLY as plan minus logged-path rate, never as an absolute. COMPLETE_M, the thetas and the 30 m margin are HYPOTHESIS. Ground truth is the NVIDIA navigation text (navtok table, flag 0 rows only; every other row is NaN). The text and the trained nav input both derive from the drive's own path, so the cells are optimistic as route-following evidence. Estimator: paired episode-cluster bootstrap (taniteval/ci.py), which answers 'another draw of episodes' only

bands.0-2s: empty by construction: a STRATEGIC cell reads the whole plan arc against the announced manoeuvre distance (median 127 m ahead, NAVPROBE), so only the full 6 s band is filled; the 0-2 s and 2-6 s bands carry n = 0
bands.2-6s: empty by construction: a STRATEGIC cell reads the whole plan arc against the announced manoeuvre distance (median 127 m ahead, NAVPROBE), so only the full 6 s band is filled; the 0-2 s and 2-6 s bands carry n = 0

not_computed.STRATEGIC.intent_6_30s: n = 0: no arm outputs an intent or goal at 6-30 s (the HWM plan is 6 s; v8f-mini's S emits route checkpoints out to 80 m only). Would-have n, MEASURED count on the 994 ACTSENS windows by time to the announced manoeuvre d / v0 (strategic-audit count_n.py): 6-12 s 32 windows, 12-30 s 69, over 30 s 20. Unblocks with a PI go on a strategic head and training
not_computed.STRATEGIC.derived_goals: n = 0: no derived-goal output exists on the HWM planner. Would-have n: n/a (no output or label is defined; STRATEGIC_PLAN section 2)
not_computed.STRATEGIC.detected_info: n = 0: no detected-information output exists on the HWM planner (the HWM ctx token is an input, not scored). Would-have n: n/a (STRATEGIC_PLAN section 2)
not_computed.STRATEGIC.S_CKPT: structural n = 0: the HWM planner has no S head, so no route checkpoint exists to score. S_CKPT is read on v8f-mini arms only; would-have n on the eval141 grid, MEASURED (proto_eval141_counts.json): 46 / 120 / 214 windows (18 / 22 / 24 episodes) at 30 / 50 / 80 m of arc

logged_path.note: the logged-action path read by the same cells; S_FALSE is read only as plan minus this rate

note: positive delta = worse for A (lower is better) except S_ADH (higher is better) and S_FALSE (neutral, plan minus logged). Estimator: paired episode-cluster bootstrap (answers 'another draw of episodes'); the replicate rows are the inference-seed floor. T0 diagnostic, never driving performance.
